subject: HelixAI POC: short extension vs token top-up — options and exception request
messages:
From: Alex Jones <alex.jones@helix.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 14 Mar 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short extension or top-up options for HelixAI POC

Hi Rachel,

We ran into a slight delay on our side — the security/compliance review for the integration landed later than expected and the team needs an extra 2–3 weeks to validate outputs before we can hand the PoC back to product.

Two questions:
- Can Redwood provide a short time-box extension (3 weeks) to the current pilot without re-negotiating the whole SOW?
- If not, can we do a token top-up instead (we estimate ~100k tokens) and is there a discount for addons for an existing pilot?

We’re keen to avoid stopping the work; this is still on track to become a paid engagement if the next phase tests well. Appreciate a quick timeline and a ballpark cost so I can run it up our chain (procure@helix.ai copied).

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jones
Head of Integrations, HelixAI

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@helix.ai>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension or top-up options for HelixAI POC

Hi Alex — thanks for the heads up and for the context. We can support both approaches; below are two pragmatic options so your team can decide quickly:

Option A — Timebox extension (recommended)
- 3 additional weeks added to the current pilot at no additional software charge, conditional on 3 weekly checkpoint calls and delivery of the evaluation metrics you referenced.
- No change to current billing; we treat this as a one-time operational extension to keep momentum.

Option B — Token top-up
- One-off 100k token pack added to the pilot.
- We can offer a 15% discount on the token list price for existing pilots, subject to finance approval for >10% discounts.

Notes: Larger discounts (>10%) require formal approval from Sales Ops/Finance — I’ve attached a quick pricing summary for both options (attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx). If you prefer Option B we’ll need a short PO or a signed amendment.

If you’re comfortable with Option A I can push the extension live today. If you prefer Option B, tell me whether Helix prefers an invoice or a credit application and I’ll route for approval.

Would you like a quick call today (15–20m) to finalize?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: HelixAI POC: short extension vs token top-up — options and exception request

Forwarding — Helix is asking for either a 3-week time extension (no charge) or a 100k token top-up with a requested discount. Customer is strategically important (integration partner) and likely to expand post-POC.

Summary for approval:
- Ask: 15% discount on 100k token top-up OR free 3-week extension.
- Impact: 15% off token pack = ~$4.5k concession (list token price used in pricing-summary.xlsx).
- Upside: high probability to convert to a dedicated deployment in H2; partner integration could be referenced in case studies.

Attachments: approval-case.pdf (one-pager why we should bend)

Can you confirm whether we can approve 15% or if we should cap at 10% and offer the free timebox instead? If we approve the discount, do you want it applied as an invoice credit or a pre-paid credit?

Thanks — Rachel

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixAI POC: short extension vs token top-up — options and exception request

Thanks for the context. Approve up to 10% unilateral discount on pilot add-ons for this cohort — any concession beyond 10% needs a short SLA/credit-risk note and sign-off from Finance. Given Helix’s partner potential, I’m comfortable with 10% as the standard exception.

Preferred approach:
- Offer the free 3-week extension first (low friction).
- If customer insists on tokens, offer 100k top-up at 10% discount and apply as a pre-paid credit on the next invoice (keeps bookkeeping simple).

I’ve attached the SOW amendment template (SOW-amendment-draft.docx) — legal will need to sign the amendment if we change billing terms.

– David
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jones <alex.jones@helix.ai>, procure@helix.ai
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short extension or top-up options for HelixAI POC

Alex — quick follow to lock this in. Per Sales Ops we can do the following:

1) Timebox extension (recommended, immediate)
- We will add a 3-week extension to your current pilot at no charge.
- Condition: weekly 30m checkpoints to confirm progress and final evaluation metrics.
- No amendment needed for the billing side; I’ll note the operational extension on the Helix project record.

OR

2) Token top-up (if you prefer tokens)
- 100k token pack at a 10% discount (approved).
- We will apply the value as a pre-paid credit on your next invoice; procurement can raise a PO referencing deal HX-2027-0421.

Next steps:
- If you take Option 1, reply to this thread and I’ll activate the extension today.
- If you take Option 2, confirm purchase method (PO vs invoice) and I’ll send the amendment + DocuSign link (attachment: SOW-amendment-draft.docx; DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/helix-amp-extension).

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
(attachment: SOW-amendment-draft.docx)
